data.gender_notes: Angad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Angad is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘angada’ which means ‘messenger’, ‘ensign’, or ‘attendant’. This name is associated with the legendary monkey king Hanuman who was an ardent devotee of Lord Rama and served as His messenger and attendant. The name Angad carries the meaning “Messenger, Ensign, Attendant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Angad usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, ensign, attendant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
